$Comment: The void bomb the Voidtaken Horseman hurls at a player from the saddle: the Headless Horseman's own aimed lob (Parent, Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Bomb_Projectile: the same arc, launch force and 5-second fuse) drawn as the game's void blast (the Void Eye's Eye_Void_Blast model). It bursts on striking a creature (ProjectileHit) or the ground (ProjectileMiss), and after 5 seconds in any case, as the shared void blast (Orbis_Boss_Void_Bomb_Burst, players only), and where it bursts it sets the ground burning (Orbis_Boss_Fire_Patch_Spawn, players only, 10 seconds). All three landings are restated, since a child's Interactions replace the parent's whole.
